mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_document (user_id, title, file_type, file_url, file_size, subject_code, parse_status, error_msg, chunk_count, is_public) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{fileType}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileSize}, #{subjectCode}, #{parseStatus}, #{errorMsg}, #{chunkCount}, #{isPublic})
mapper.select: SELECT id, document_id, chunk_index, content, token_count, page_number, bbox_json, image_url, vector_id, created_at FROM kb_chunk WHERE document_id = #{documentId} ORDER BY chunk_index ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_chunk (document_id, chunk_index, content, token_count, page_number, bbox_json, image_url, vector_id) VALUES (#{documentId}, #{chunkIndex}, #{content}, #{tokenCount}, #{pageNumber}, #{bboxJson}, #{imageUrl}, #{vectorId})
mapper.select: SELECT code, name, icon, sort_order, description FROM k_subject ORDER BY sort_order ASC
SELECT id, subject_code, title, chapter_number, layer, sort_order FROM k_chapter WHERE subject_code = #{subjectCode} ORDER BY sort_order ASC

SELECT p.id, p.section_id, p.title, p.summary, p.importance, p.exam_frequency, p.tags_json, p.sort_order FROM k_point p JOIN k_section s ON p.section_id = s.id JOIN k_chapter c ON s.chapter_id = c.id WHERE c.subject_code = #{subjectCode} ORDER BY p.exam_frequency DESC
